_note: Template colours for Modern Muscle: the Exotic rules and finish (stage_b/data/colours.json). Primary, Secondary and (cockpit) Neon come from the native build paint in scripts/vehicle_blockouts/specs/muscle.json. The game repaints Primary, Secondary, Detail, Neon and ThrustColor parts at spawn and in previews, so template colours on those channels only matter when a template is viewed raw in Studio. Glass and lamp colours are final: no script touches them.
_paintVariant: MaterialVariant name written on every primary paint part (base SmoothPlastic). Muscle reuses MaterialService.ExoticFlakePaint, which the Exotic install created; without it the parts show plain SmoothPlastic.
_lamp: kitNeon = the native neon paint of the cockpit that owns the kit (as the blockout shows it). A hex value here gives every Front Body and Rear Body lamp that colour instead.
_meshLamp: Only read for mesh modules. Muscle has none yet; kept so that a later data/mesh.json needs no change here.
_defaultLights: DefaultFrontLightsColor and DefaultRearLightsColor are the values every Piercer cockpit carries.
_glass: Dark tint at 0.15 transparency, as Exotic. The placeholder cabins are solid glass blocks, so a seated driver is mostly hidden until the real models come.
